ours: monthly stock prices (price at end of month t-1)
stock price history over the past 12 months (highest price, i.e. 52-week high)

signal_formula_words.ours: Nearness to the 52-week high: the stock's price at the end of month t-1 divided by its highest price during the 12-month period ending on the last day of month t-1.
signal_formula_words.reference: P_i,t-1 / high_i,t-1 where P is the month-end price and high is the highest price over the 12 months ending at the end of month t-1

formation_window.ours: 12 months (highest price over the 12-month period ending on the last day of month t-1)
formation_window.reference: 12-month high; ranking at end of month t-1

skip_window.ours: none (no skip month in Tables I-IV; one month is skipped only in the regression tests)

rebalance_frequency.ours: monthly (overlapping portfolios: month-t return is the equally weighted average of six portfolios formed in months t-6 to t-1)

breakpoints.ours: Top 30% (winners) and bottom 30% (losers) of all sample stocks ranked by the 52-week high measure; remaining 40% is the middle portfolio. NYSE breakpoints are not mentioned.

favored_group.ours: winner portfolio: top 30% of stocks with the highest ratio of current price to 52-week high (long leg)
favored_group.reference: 30% of stocks closest to their 52-week high

disfavored_group.ours: loser portfolio: bottom 30% of stocks with the lowest ratio of current price to 52-week high (short leg)
disfavored_group.reference: 30% of stocks farthest from their 52-week high
